data.name: Muana
data.gender_notes: Muana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mūla’ meaning root and ‘an’ meaning nourished, Muana symbolizes being nourished by the moon. In Hindu mythology, the moon is considered a symbol of peace, tranquility, and nourishment, making Muana a beautiful name for a baby girl. The name Muana carries the meaning “Nourished by the moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Muana usually hope their child will grow to embody nourished by the moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessed by the celestial nourisher, the moon.
data.etymology: Muana belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Nourished by the moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muana total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
